title: Revit/ZEN level and grid alignment check

input_contract.subject: Governed levels and grids in the tested Revit document.
required_governance_inputs: governed coordinate transform or spatial basis
preconditions: The document is readable through an approved Revit API execution context.
The approved datum/grid source can be resolved into the tested document coordinate context or explicitly marked unresolved.

steps: Enumerate levels and record stable id, name, elevation, and relevant scope.
Enumerate grids and record stable id, identity/name, curve/position representation, and relevant scope.
Resolve the governed comparison source and coordinate basis.
Compare level identities/elevations and grid identities/positions against the governed source using approved tolerances where applicable.
Record duplicates, offsets, mismatches, competing datum systems, and unresolved transforms.
Map observations to ATS result states.
execution_contract.safety_boundary: Read-only. The checker shall not move, rename, create, delete, pin, or unpin levels/grids or modify shared coordinates.
execution_contract.authority_boundary: The ETS observes alignment to S6 spatial authority; it does not establish or change project coordinates.

required_observations: finding records with datum id/name and observed versus governed position

result_mapping.pass: All applicable levels and grids match the complete governed source and spatial comparison rules.
result_mapping.fail: At least one applicable level/grid positively conflicts with the governed identity or spatial rule.
result_mapping.not_applicable: No governed level/grid rule applies to the tested model.
result_mapping.indeterminate: The approved source, coordinate transform, or required comparison tolerance is unavailable or ambiguous.

provenance.migration_note: Appendix E Revit/ZEN ETS contract. It does not invent coordinate tolerances or naming codes absent from governance.
